admission.justification: Two proving tests pin the tracked-sibling refusal and the truthful eligible release; without them a release could silently take a tracked file.

applicability: Comparison-snapshot generation release through the generation owner.
conditions: The generation is wholly eligible apart from a tracked sibling.
statement: Releasing one eligible comparison snapshot through its generation owner can delete its Git-tracked sibling even though that sibling is excluded from the reviewed deletion list.
